description: Inspect CSS progressively without flooding the model. Default summary returns compact final computed values plus direct-rule and inherited-rule/source counts. Use detail computed for selected properties, rules for paginated declarations, or full for the complete cascade.

backendNodeId.description: Backend DOM node ID from an accessibility snapshot

contextId.description: Optional isolated context; context tab IDs are negative

detail.description: Response detail; summary is compact and the default

includeDeclarations.description: Include declaration arrays in rule results; default false for summary

includeInherited.description: Include ancestor rules; default false except full

properties.description: Exact computed properties; takes precedence over the default summary set
